datasets.label: Meals and events

anchor.title: Event
anchor.description: What the events are aligned on: Meal (a carb entry), CorrectionBolus (a manual bolus with no meal near it), SensorStart, ExerciseStart, OverrideStart, TemporaryTargetStart, UnannouncedRise (a meal-like rise with no carbs logged), LowStart, HighStart, SiteChange (a site, cannula or pod change), SleepStart and Wake (the start and end of a sleep session, naps included; need the sleep permission), LowTreatment (the first carbs logged during a low) or AnyBolus (every manual bolus, for a meal or not). LowStart is the first reading of a low and HighStart the first reading of a high, by the rule the glucose statistics count lows and highs by: a low starts after at least 15 minutes of readings below 70 mg/dL (3.9 mmol/L), a high after at least 15 minutes above 180 mg/dL (10.0 mmol/L), and each ends after at least 15 minutes back in range or at a gap in the readings. These limits are the same for everyone, not the profile's target.

others.title: All others
others.description: All the events of this kind in the range that no other group of the same kind takes in. It takes no filter or condition of its own, and needs another group of the same kind. One such group for each kind at most.

fromMinute.title: From
fromMinute.description: Start, minutes after local midnight, 0 to 1439.

toMinute.title: To
toMinute.description: End, exclusive, minutes after local midnight, 0 to 1439.

timeOfDay.title: Time of day
timeOfDay.description: Only events in this local time-of-day window. Optional.

grams.title: Meal size (g)
grams.description: Meal cohorts only: only meals of this size. Optional.

dayOfWeek.title: Weekdays
dayOfWeek.description: Only events on these local weekdays. Optional; every day when missing.

foods.title: Foods
foods.description: Meal groups only: the foods to match. A meal matches when it has a food record of one of them. Meals with carbs only and no food record cannot match and are counted apart. Needs the food permission.

foodCategory.title: Food category
foodCategory.description: Meal groups only: a food category. A meal matches when it has a food record of that category. Needs the food permission.

min.title: Min
min.description: Fewest minutes since the last carbs, 1 to 1440. Optional.

max.title: Max
max.description: Most minutes since the last carbs, 1 to 1440. Optional.

minutesSinceMeal.title: Minutes since carbs
minutesSinceMeal.description: Only events with this many minutes since the last carb entry before them. Optional. Needs the treatments permission.

min.title: Min
min.description: Lowest glucose at the event, mg/dL, 0 to 600. Optional.

max.title: Max
max.description: Highest glucose at the event, mg/dL, 0 to 600. Optional.

startGlucose.title: Glucose at the event
startGlucose.description: Only events with a glucose at the event in this range, in mg/dL. Optional.

insulinOnBoard.title: IOB at the event
insulinOnBoard.description: Only events with this insulin on board at the event. Events with no IOB value at the time are counted apart. Optional. Needs the treatments permission.

cohorts.title: Event groups
cohorts.description: The cohorts, 1 to 6. Optional; every meal when missing. The Meals and events page shows at most 3. Groups 1 to 5 each have their own color; group 6 has the color of group 1.

minutesBefore.title: Minutes before each event
minutesBefore.description: The part of each event's window before the event.

minutesAfter.title: Minutes after each event
minutesAfter.description: The part of each event's window after the event.

isolatedOnly.title: Only events with nothing else near them
isolatedOnly.description: Only events with no other meal, correction bolus or unannounced rise in their window. Needs the treatments permission.

requireCorroboration.title: Count only rises with extra insulin
requireCorroboration.description: Count an unannounced rise only where the loop answered it with extra insulin. Needs the treatments permission.

comparisonRange.title: Comparison range
comparisonRange.description: A second range of local dates to compare with, drawn as its own series. Optional.

excludeOverrides.title: Exclude overrides
excludeOverrides.description: Leave out time an override ran. Needs the treatments permission.

excludeTemporaryTargets.title: Exclude temporary targets
excludeTemporaryTargets.description: Leave out time a temporary target ran. Needs the treatments permission.

excludeExercise.title: Exclude exercise
excludeExercise.description: Leave out exercise time. Needs the treatments permission.

excludeIllness.title: Exclude illness
excludeIllness.description: Leave out illness time. Needs the treatments permission.

excludeOpenLoop.title: Exclude manual mode
excludeOpenLoop.description: Leave out time the pump was in manual mode or had no AID algorithm. Needs the devices permission.

profileName.title: Profile name
profileName.description: Analyze only time this profile was active. Optional. Needs the therapy settings permission.

Meal.description: A carb entry; entries at the same instant are one meal.

CorrectionBolus.description: A manual bolus with no carbs logged from 30 minutes before it to an hour after it.

SensorStart.description: A CGM sensor start or change; records within two hours are one new sensor.

ExerciseStart.description: The start of an exercise span.

TemporaryTargetStart.description: The start of a temporary target.

UnannouncedRise.description: A meal-like glucose rise with no carbs logged near it.

LowStart.description: The first reading of a low.
LowStart.rule: A low starts after at least 15 minutes of readings below 70 mg/dL (3.9 mmol/L), a high after at least 15 minutes above 180 mg/dL (10.0 mmol/L), and each ends after at least 15 minutes back in range or at a gap in the readings. These limits are the same for everyone, not the profile's target.

HighStart.description: The first reading of a high.
HighStart.rule: A low starts after at least 15 minutes of readings below 70 mg/dL (3.9 mmol/L), a high after at least 15 minutes above 180 mg/dL (10.0 mmol/L), and each ends after at least 15 minutes back in range or at a gap in the readings. These limits are the same for everyone, not the profile's target.

SiteChange.description: An infusion site, cannula or pod change, or a pod activated; records within two hours are one change.

SleepStart.description: The start of a sleep session, naps included.

Wake.description: The end of a sleep session.

LowTreatment.description: The first carbs logged during a low.
LowTreatment.rule: A low starts after at least 15 minutes of readings below 70 mg/dL (3.9 mmol/L), a high after at least 15 minutes above 180 mg/dL (10.0 mmol/L), and each ends after at least 15 minutes back in range or at a gap in the readings. These limits are the same for everyone, not the profile's target.

AnyBolus.description: Every manual bolus, for a meal or not; automatic boluses are not.
